#Electric Bike Rentals

##Duration

Full Day - 8 hours 

##About

Come experience the thrill of pedal-assisted biking, and see Laguna like you've never seen it before. You'll experience how easy it is to traverse our town safely without ever getting on Coast Highway. You'll see historic homes, local art, points of interest, and some of the most beautiful neighborhoods and architecture in the world.
**More information will be provided in the  confirmation email.**
